item.title: Zhou Weilin (周威霖)
item.description: Zhou Weilin (周威霖) Zhou Weilin (周威霖) is a Taiwanese American community figure who served as Secretary General (秘書長) of the Taiwanese American Historical Society (TAHS) and contributed multiple profiles to the 2017 TAHS Publication (台美菁英錄).
